q: The Professional Tax Receipt is best described as:
o: a national income tax on professionals
a percentage tax on gross receipts
ans: an annual regulatory fee paid to the local government
w: The Professional Tax Receipt is an annual local (LGU) fee that licenses a professional to practice in that locality. It is not a national income tax or a PRC fee.
k: PTR = annual local government professional fee.

q: The basic individual community tax (cedula) is computed as:
o: P500 plus P1 per P1,000 income
ans: P5 basic plus P1 for every P1,000 of income
w: An individual pays a P5 basic community tax plus P1 for each P1,000 of income. A corporation instead has a P500 basic.
k: Individual cedula = P5 + P1 per P1,000.

q: The added basic community tax for a corporate optical shop is:
w: A corporation pays a P500 basic community tax, versus the P5 basic for an individual, plus the income-based additional amount.

q: An optical clinic with P2.5 million in annual sales is classified as, and taxed with:
w: Sales below the P3 million VAT threshold make the business non-VAT, subject to the 3% percentage tax on gross receipts instead of VAT.

q: The expanded withholding tax rate applied to the rental of a commercial space is:
w: Rental income is subject to a 5% expanded (creditable) withholding tax, so P16,789 rent yields P839.45 withheld.

q: Which statement about the community tax is correct?
o: it is paid to the BIR
payment is due only upon business closure
ans: late payment beyond February is subject to interest
w: The community tax is due by the end of February; paying later incurs interest. It is a local tax, not a BIR collection.
k: Cedula due by February; late = interest.

q: To expand a solo-owned optical clinic into another city or municipality, the owner must:
o: secure PRC approval for the branch
ans: obtain a new business permit from that local government
w: Each local government requires its own business permit, so a new location needs a new permit from that LGU, not just an amendment of the original.
k: New LGU location = new business permit.

q: Which document must be registered with the Bureau of Internal Revenue to record business transactions?
w: The BIR requires registered books of accounts to record income and expenses. The permit, PTR, and DTI registration serve other purposes.
k: BIR transaction record = books of accounts.

q: An examinee obtains a general weighted average of 76% but a 48% rating in one theoretical subject. The result is:
w: Passing requires both a passing general average and no rating below the minimum floor, so a 48% in one subject fails the candidate despite the 76% average.
k: A subject below the floor fails, whatever the average.

q: For renewal of the Professional Identification Card, an optometrist generally must complete:
w: Renewal of the PIC generally requires 15 continuing professional development units for the profession.

q: An optometrist who prescribes and endorses an ophthalmic product not registered with the FDA is committing:
w: Endorsing or dispensing an unregistered product violates the law governing regulated products and constitutes unlawful practice.
k: Endorsing an unregistered product = unlawful practice.

q: A patient who has paid for the consultation requests a copy of the spectacle prescription. The correct response is to:
ans: release the prescription as part of the patient's records
w: The prescription is part of the patient's record and belongs to the patient once the service is paid, so it must be released on request.
k: Paid patient is entitled to the prescription.
